subject: [video] DONE WP02: fake Apple runtime ready
body: Complete and host-tested. Files: fake/fake_apple.h, fake/fake_apple.c, fake/fake_vt.c, fake/test/t_fake.c, fake/run_tests.sh, fake/STATUS.json (+ dsh/workers/WP02/STATUS.md). Commands/results: (1) bash gpu/video/fake/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST WP02 PASS 10/10 (ASan+UBSan, then the same suite rebuilt under TSan -> N2TEST WP02 PASS 10/10). (2) clang -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -DN2_HOST_FAKE -I gpu/video/include -I gpu/video/fake -c gpu/video/fake/*.c -> no output, exit 0. (3) Integration: bash gpu/video/vt/test_avc_vt/run_tests.sh (WP05 links these fake sources) -> N2TEST WP05 PASS 706/706. The suite includes internal tests: dictionary order/overwrite/retain counts, 178x146 strides 192/192 with chroma 73 rows and 178 used bytes, SPS/PPS copy round trip, toy 64-byte-storage encoder through n2fake_session_* (emit count, token match, finalize once, live count restored), double/unknown emit protocol errors, concurrent intern/refcount/live-counter use, and address-taking of every n2_apple.h/n2vt_abi.h symbol. New accessors WP05 asked for are in: n2fake_session_vtable(), n2fake_session_encoder(). Assumptions for review are in fake/STATUS.json known_risks (CFDictionary overwrite keeps the original key; eager block allocation; i420 chroma stride; only first NAL SPS checked; finalize without invalidate; interned strings exempt from live count). No phone/iOS/network touched. Standing by for review requests.
